edges.reason: _mintAmount controls the mint loop bounds and iteration count
_mintAmount is multiplied by cost in the payable value requirement
cost state variable is read in the cost * _mintAmount multiplication
msg.sender becomes the mint recipient via _msgSender in the loop
withdraw send target and onlyOwner check depend on msg.sender
transferOwnership relies on _msgSender matching owner for authorization
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random index computation (timestamp dependency)
The weak randomness computation executes inside nextToken
mint calls nextToken to obtain each token id
nextToken's return value is assigned to mintIndex in the mint loop
mintIndex is passed into _safeMint which performs the external receiver callback
mint invokes _safeMint for every iteration before finishing its own state updates
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after _mint
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract
A malicious receiver can re-enter mint during the safe mint callback loop
Loop counter i drives the mint iterations
mint reads maxXIA for the total supply cap check
mint reads maxMintAmount for the per-transaction amount check
mint reads the paused flag to gate execution
The cost multiplication is evaluated as part of mint's require checks
withdraw executes the low-level send of the contract balance
The send transfers value to the caller controlled msg.sender address
_owner parameter selects which address enumeration is queried
tokenId parameter is used in tokenURI and existence check
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata location
_baseURI returns the stored baseURI state variable
_safeMint calls _mint before performing the receiver check
constructor initializes the Ownable _owner through _setOwner(_msgSender())
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner after the onlyOwner check
The random hash value is assigned to the random index local
The random computation uses maxIndex as the modulo bound
random index selects the matrix value stored in value
maxIndex determines which matrix slot value may be copied
value plus startFrom is returned as the next token id
nextToken reads maxSupply when computing maxIndex
nextToken reads and increments _tokenCount for availability tracking

normalization_plan.reason: The _mintAmount parameter only exists to bound the mint loop and belongs to the mint function node
The _owner parameter is an argument of walletOfOwner and is fully absorbed by that function node
The tokenId parameter is an argument of tokenURI and is fully absorbed by that function node
mintIndex is a loop-local temporary whose only security-relevant use is the _safeMint callback it feeds
The loop counter i is an internal control artifact of the mint loop and merges into mint
The random local is a direct product of the unsafe randomness computation and merges into it
The maxIndex local only participates in the unsafe randomness modulo and merges into that operation
The value local is produced and consumed entirely within nextToken and merges into that function
